songs.title: vintage vuitton
songs.verdict: A Dublin newcomer's 90-second haze: relaxed, nostalgic and offhandedly catchy enough that the video passed half a million views in two weeks.
songs.body:
earfzilla is a Dublin rapper who started releasing music in March 2026 and has been covered by Nialler9, Teen Vogue and Acid Stag as a fast-rising name in the city's underground.
"vintage vuitton" is a short, hazy, laid-back single that ran ahead of his debut mixtape THE AFTER GLOW (Nov 13, 2026).
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (cloud rap, Ireland). Released Sep 25, 2026 per Apple Music ((P) 2026 Playing for keeps!!!, looks self-released). Video passed 500k views in two weeks per Nialler9 / Da Playlister (Oct 28, 2026: https://daplaylister.substack.com/p/earfzilla-is-putting-dublins-underground). Acid Stag post with the YouTube and SoundCloud embeds: https://acidstag.com/2026/10/earfzilla-vintage-vuitton/. Audiomack: https://audiomack.com/earfzilla/song/vintage-vuitton-5362318. Alternative: debut mixtape THE AFTER GLOW (Nov 13, 2026), no direct link seen. CHECK LISTENERS: viral video plus Teen Vogue coverage means he could be near 100k. Cover left empty (Apple artwork seen, but let the site find it).

songs.title: The Kids Want Sutetchi 3: A Happy Chaos For Everyone
songs.verdict: Another short burst of grimy SoundCloud chaos from a New Orleans rapper-producer the FADER credits with never making the same drop twice.
songs.body:
Dani Kiyoko is a 23-year-old New Orleans rapper-producer whom the FADER's Opener column credits with helping shape the VampPlugg and swag-nostalgia sounds, with ten solo full-lengths since 2024.
The third Sutetchi tape is 10 self-released tracks of rage-leaning SoundCloud rap, their second project in about six weeks.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (rage / vampplugg, New Orleans). Released Nov 6, 2026 per Apple Music ((P) 2026 Sutetchi, self-run). Buzz: FADER Opener profile (May 4, 2026: https://www.thefader.com/2026/05/04/the-opener-dani-kiyoko-has-their-finger-on-the-pulse-of-soundcloud-rap). Backup pick: LOVELY HALLOWS (Sep 25, 2026). Apple artist page: https://music.apple.com/us/artist/dani-kiyoko/1443926644. Listener count unchecked (Spotify blocked) but likely well under 100k. No SoundCloud link for this tape seen; profile is artist_url. Pick a standout track when reviewing.

songs.title: Ay Yo
songs.verdict: A 97-second jab from one of the new-class Atlanta rappers Pigeons & Planes says are reigniting the city's underground.
songs.body:
Bby Kell is an Atlanta rapper whom Pigeons & Planes grouped with Tezzus, Sk8star and Zukenee in its March 2026 piece on Atlanta's new rap class, then named a Best New Artist for Fall 2026.
"Ay Yo" is a short self-released single, his newest after the 2026 album GIRLY POP and a steady run of singles.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (Atlanta new wave / underground trap). Released Oct 16, 2026 per Apple Music ((P) 2026 Bby Kell, self-released). Buzz: P&P Best New Artists Fall 2026 (Oct 29: https://www.pigeonsandplanes.com/read/best-new-artists-fall-2026) and P&P's Atlanta scene piece (https://www.pigeonsandplanes.com/read/atlanta-rap-scene-tezzus-sk8star-zukenee-oway-interview). DOUBTS: Apple has a second 'Bby Kell' artist ID (1835297122), so confirm this is the Atlanta rapper before publishing. No written description of his sound in the sources, so the verdict is a placeholder; listen first. Listener count unknown, likely small.

songs.title: BANDIT'S MANIFESTO
songs.verdict: A London rap auteur's jerk-inspired boast on heavy 808s, playful about cartoons, skating and custom clothes, and DIY right down to the video edit.
songs.body:
JoeJas is a London-based rapper, producer and director with a zany, genre-hopping catalogue, previously covered by ASBO Magazine, Tinnitist and The Luna Collective.
"BANDIT'S MANIFESTO" is self-produced and self-directed, takes cues from jerk, and pairs bragging with lines about making it with his friends.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (jerk-adjacent UK rap). Source: Acid Stag, Nov 11-12, 2026 (https://acidstag.com/2026/11/joejas-bandits-manifesto/), calls it a DIY release; YouTube and SoundCloud links come from that post's embeds. Exact release date not confirmed beyond that post (clearly Nov 2026). Older catalogue on Bandcamp (https://joejas.bandcamp.com). Releasing since ~2020, so not brand new, but tiny: no label, small press. No listener count found.

songs.title: A BORN SOULJÄ
songs.verdict: Hard-edged Bronx street rap over moody, soulful beats: a no-frills 14-tracker of the kind monthly dig lists exist to surface.
songs.body:
Hahyeem is an independent Bronx MC who has self-released steadily since 2019, with CD runs through UK boom-bap label Chopped Herring.
A BORN SOULJÄ is a 14-track album pairing tough street narratives with dark, soulful production from several producers.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (NYC boom bap). Released Oct 28, 2026 per Hip Hop Golden Age's October round-up (https://hiphopgoldenage.com/list/october-2026-round-up-the-9-best-hip-hop-albums-of-the-month/). Deezer artist page: https://www.deezer.com/us/artist/12538760. He also dropped a 2-song single SUKI on Nov 15, 2026 (https://music.apple.com/us/album/suki-single/6829839332). Weakest 'on the way up' fit (working vet), but clearly tiny and independent.

songs.title: Timing.
songs.verdict: Jerk rap's restless bounce routed through the Caribbean, with zouk and bouyon swing sitting under rage-era synths.
songs.body:
Ricky Bishop is an underground rapper whose music is tagged across French-Caribbean styles (zouk, bouyon, compas) and internet rap (jerk, rage).
Timing. is a full-length that tries to merge jerk and rage production with Caribbean dance rhythms and alt-R&B melodies.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane, hyper-rap edge (jerk / rage x French-Caribbean). Released Oct 16, 2026 per idontknowerik's Weekly Wrap Up Oct 12-18 (https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-12th-2026-oct); all four links come from that post. Only source found, so the bio is limited to its genre tags. Listener count and label status unknown; likely small, but check. Pick a standout track.

songs.title: Hardcore Software
songs.verdict: A debut album typed out line by line in code that still means to hit like a sweaty rave, dragging trance, jungle and hardcore toward pop.
songs.body:
DJ_Dave is a live-coding producer who has spent about seven years performing music written in code in real time; she releases on the independent label Mad Decent and is a Beatport Next artist.
Her 12-track debut is live coded start to finish, aiming high-energy rave, trance and hardstyle at the pop and hyperpop crowd.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane (hypertrance / glitch-pop edge). Released Oct 2, 2026. Coverage: Acid Stag (https://acidstag.com/2026/10/dj_dave-hardcore-software-lp/, Spotify embed + SoundCloud artist link), Beatportal Oct 6 (https://www.beatportal.com/articles/1657923-dj-dave-releases-debut-album-hardcore-software-on-mad-decent), NPR Oct 5, idontknowerik Best of 2K26 list. CHECK LISTENER COUNT: Mad Decent is indie, but NPR coverage means she may be near or over 100k. Beatportal highlights the single 'Give it 2 me.'

songs.title: loser
songs.verdict: Starts as raw, Auto-Tuned digicore, then floors it into neon hardstyle EDM.
songs.body:
lj is an underground rapper from the Japanese internet-music scene who previously rapped over wheezing trap beats.
"loser" is described as moving from raw digicore into maxed-out EDM, with hardstyle drums, neon synths and Auto-Tuned vocals.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane (digicore into hypertrance EDM, Japanese internet scene). Source: scrmbl selection 9 November 2026 (https://scrmbl.substack.com/p/scrmbl-selection-9-november-2026), a weekly list of new songs from the past week, so released roughly Nov 2-9, 2026. YouTube link converted from that post's embed; I couldn't open it to confirm the channel. 'lj' is an easy name to confuse, so verify the video and artist before publishing. Japan is inferred from the outlet's focus. Tiny; numbers unknown.

songs.title: SICKBUG
songs.verdict: A rough-edged rap-and-sing group drives straight into a huge hardstyle drop, catches its breath for a verse, then stomps right back in.
songs.body:
VINII is a Japanese vocal group that sings and raps over rough production and leans toward digicore and hard trance.
"SICKBUG" is a hardstyle-driven track whose big drop was produced by DE DE MOUSE.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane (hypertrance / digicore edge, Japanese alt-idol scene). Source: scrmbl selection 9 November 2026 (https://scrmbl.substack.com/p/scrmbl-selection-9-november-2026), new songs from the past week, so ~Nov 2-9, 2026. YouTube URL converted from the post's embed, not opened. DOUBTS: may be an idol group with management or a label deal; confirm label status and listener count before publishing.

songs.title: the experience
songs.verdict: A 25-song collective dump from SoundCloud's jugg fringe: delay-soaked 808s, pitched-up voices and blown-out bass.
songs.body:
25r3set is a teen SoundCloud collective in the 'jugg' microscene, founded in March 2025 and now run by producers/rappers faux and cylis.
the experience is a 25-song tape released to celebrate the collective reaching 1,000 followers.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane (digicore / jerk-adjacent SoundCloud fringe). Source: No Bells, '808s & delay: Jugg, jerk, and the new fringe of music' by Kieran Press-Reynolds, Nov 11, 2026 (https://nobells.blog/808s-delay-jugg-jerk-and-the-new-fringe-of-music/), which says the tape 'just dropped'; SoundCloud link taken from the article. Exact upload date unconfirmed. Collective, not a single artist. That article names ~25 more scene artists (ocelot, cylis, dusk, Stovyy...) for future batches. Pick a standout track.

songs.title: Pixel Perfect
songs.verdict: Glittery Y2K indie pop on a frame of midwest-emo guitar, like a basement show watched through a scratched pink camcorder lens.
songs.body:
screenager is the New Jersey band led by Adri Maiella, which started as a lockdown songwriting project and is now a four-piece.
This second EP has guitar-driven songs about identity, heartbreak and the expectations put on young women, with Mazzy Star, Soccer Mommy and early Avril Lavigne as touchpoints.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane (emo-leaning indie pop/rock). Released Oct 16, 2026 on Rose Garden Records (Bandcamp; producer Connor Hanson). The 9-track release includes 4 tracks from the 2024 Striker EP; the new songs are tracks 1-5, and Ones To Watch singles out 'Rockstar' and 'Three of Me'. Buzz: Ones To Watch feature + Q&A Nov 11, 2026 (https://www.onestowatch.com/en/blog/screenager-finds-beauty-and-courage-in-falling-apart-on-pixel-perfect-q-a); Spotify link from that page's embed. Very small (Brooklyn/Montclair venues), but check listener count.

songs.title: Wishing On Numbers
songs.verdict: Emo bones wrapped in shoegaze haze, from a Canberra five-piece making the title track of their debut album.
songs.body:
Spouse is a five-piece from Canberra, Australia, on the indie label Gutwrench Records.
The title track from their debut album mixes emo and alt-rock with shoegaze and indie-rock textures, ahead of the full record on Nov 27.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane (emo/shoegaze). Single released Oct 30, 2026; debut album due Nov 27, 2026 on Gutwrench Records. Source: Atwood Magazine Editor's Picks 172, Nov 14, 2026 (https://atwoodmagazine.com/ep172-editors-picks-2026-11-14/); YouTube link from that page's embed. Name is very hard to search, so no Spotify/Bandcamp/IG found. Almost certainly small, but check.

songs.title: Swallowed Flame
songs.verdict: Whispered vocals smothered by distorted guitar and restless bass: Swedish winter melancholy as a slow-burning shoegaze-emo hybrid.
songs.body:
Menderbug is a roughly year-old duo from rural southern Sweden (Marcus on vocals, Jonas on bass) that puts out about one release a month.
This single from their second EP, Fading Signs, mixes shoegaze, slowcore, 90s emo and post-punk tension around something quietly burning under the surface.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane (shoegaze/slowcore/emo). Source: Joy of Violent Movement, Nov 10, 2026 (https://joyofviolentmovement.com/new-audio-swedens-menderbug-shares-shimmering-swallowed-flame/), which says the Fading Signs EP came out 'last Friday' (~Nov 6, 2026); the single itself may be a few weeks older, still in window. YouTube link is that post's embed; uploader not named, so confirm it's official. IG handle credited in an IDIOTEQ interview (Apr 22, 2026: https://idioteq.com/swedish-duo-menderbug/). Very small.

songs.title: Trapezoid
songs.verdict: Scuzzy guitars, pounding drums and post-punk tension from a former sunny-indie-pop songwriter deliberately knocking her sound off its axis.
songs.body:
total tommy is the project of Sydney-based, Melbourne-born songwriter Jess Holt, who used to make breezy indie pop as Essie Holt.
Her 11-track second album aims for distorted 90s-grunge grit and post-punk unease.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane (indie rock/grunge). Album released Oct 23, 2026 on Play It Again Sam (independent). Source: Atwood Magazine track-by-track, Oct 30, 2026 (https://atwoodmagazine.com/trapezoid-total-tommy-album-interview-music-feature/); Spotify album embed and title-track video from that page, IG/Linktree from its artist links. DOUBT: most established act here (second album, Australian radio support), so check monthly listeners against 100k and drop if well over.

songs.title: Outside
songs.verdict: A moodier, more melancholic turn after the swagger of 'BackRoom', built for a late-night drive once summer's already gone.
songs.body:
JeRonelle is an independent R&B/soul singer-songwriter and former contestant on Fox's The Four.
"Outside" leans into longing for a night out with someone after summer ends; he co-wrote and co-produced it with Kori James and Who_Shot_Jon.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. Released Oct 2, 2026 (artist's X post: https://x.com/ImJeRonelle/status/2103633881077596546). Featured in Rated R&B '12 Essential New R&B Releases' (Oct 2, 2026: https://ratedrnb.com/2026/10/new-releases-lalah-hathaway-victoria-monet-nao/); Spotify URL from that page's embed. Audiomack: https://audiomack.com/jeronelle/song/outside. CHECK LISTENERS: TV exposure on The Four may put him near the line. No official IG source found (X: @ImJeRonelle).

songs.title: Cologne (Vol. I)
songs.verdict: A five-song slow burn billed as 'international R&B', soulful and atmospheric, built around the scent-memory of a late grandfather.
songs.body:
Cedric Brazle is a Florida-born R&B singer-songwriter and trained pianist who started in an alt-rock band before moving into what he calls 'contemporary nostalgia.'
Cologne (Vol. I) is a cinematic five-track EP about romance, heartbreak and self-reflection; focus track 'casanova.' is a male duet with Reggie Becton that flips the premise of 'The Boy Is Mine.'
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. Out by Oct 16, 2026 via Emperium Entertainment (looks independent): That Eric Alper (https://www.thatericalper.com/2026/10/16/cedric-brazle-explores-love-heartbreak-and-memory-on-new-ep-cologne-vol-i/) and Rated R&B Oct 16 (https://ratedrnb.com/2026/10/new-releases-lucky-daye-snoh-aalegra-jawan/, source of the Spotify album link). Also covered by YouKnowIGotSoul and The Garnette Report. Listener count unknown; coverage is all small R&B outlets.

songs.title: Say
songs.verdict: Bubbling percussion and sawing synths give way to a fractured, bass-heavy breakbeat lurch, with Kampala street sounds cutting through the dub chords.
songs.body:
Masaka Masaka is a Ugandan producer whose new EP XA was written between Kampala and Switzerland.
"Say" opens the three-track XA EP on Creaked Records and stitches field recordings of Kampala's streets into a jagged club track.
songs.scout_note: Left-field electronic lane (experimental breakbeat / broken beat). Premiered on Inverted Audio Oct 28, 2026 (https://inverted-audio.com/premiere-masaka-masaka-say/); XA EP (Creaked Records) out Nov 6, 2026 ('Say', 'MXL' feat. Hibotep, 'Walls'). YouTube URL converted from the premiere's embed; check it plays 'Say'. Very underground: small label, no Spotify link seen.

songs.title: Okay
songs.verdict: Falsetto pushed into the stratosphere over popping, whirring beats: Copenhagen avant-pop that sounds like a club kid who grew up on acoustic guitar.
songs.body:
Yangze is Copenhagen producer-singer Jakob Littauer, who played Berghain at 16 in a teen techno group and has produced for Ydegirl and others in the Escho orbit.
"Okay" opens his Escho debut album Heartbreak Stew, mixing acoustic guitar, metallic percussion and processed vocals into glitchy electronic pop.
songs.scout_note: Left-field electronic lane (leftfield pop-electronic). 'Okay' released Sep 23-24, 2026 as the third album preview: Stereogum Sep 23 (https://stereogum.com/2512374/yangze-announces-debut-album-heartbreak-stew-hear-okay/music), Dork Sep 24 (https://readdork.com/news/yangze-announces-heartbreak-stew-okay-d90c3434d1, source of the YouTube embed). Album Heartbreak Stew on Escho (indie; Smerz/Ydegirl's label), out Nov 13 per most sources (Line of Best Fit says Nov 21); Bandcamp Daily Essential Release Nov 13. Could review the album instead. Probably under 100k, but a Clairo collab may have lifted him; check.

songs.title: Froschprotokoll
songs.verdict: A playful modular-synth wander full of blips and warbling tones, pitched by its label as everyday objects drawn in a crude paint program.
songs.body:
Soft Blizzards is the project of German composer Ulf Schütte, who works in modular synthesis.
"Froschprotokoll" comes from the Nasses Raster tape on the LA label Not Not Fun: an upbeat, exploratory piece of psychedelic machine music.
songs.scout_note: Left-field electronic lane (ambient / experimental). Premiered on Inverted Audio Sep 23, 2026 (https://inverted-audio.com/premiere-soft-blizzards-froschprotokoll); Nasses Raster tape out on Not Not Fun Oct 2, 2026. YouTube URL converted from the premiere's embed; check it's 'Froschprotokoll'. Very underground (cassette label, no Spotify seen). Most niche pick in the batch.
